summary: Full backend + frontend testing of yesno app. All 8 backend pytest cases passed (definite YES/NO, probabilistic, validation errors 422 for empty/short/long, no key leak). All UI flows verified via Playwright at desktop & mobile viewports: search, submit, loading state, answer display (YES for Paris capital), reason panel toggle (WHY/EVIDENCE), probability bars for probabilistic questions, history persistence & Clear, reset via logo, example question pills.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); consider FastAPI lifespan handler.
Minor: /api/answer catches broad Exception around sanitize but a clean 502 message is returned - acceptable.
Positive: no mongo _id leaks; probabilities normalized server-side; validation via pydantic field_validator with clear 422 responses; sources array intentionally allowed empty (matches spec).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses Emergent LLM key with Claude Sonnet 4.6. LLM calls take 5-15s so use >=45s wait for answer-display selector. All data-testid attributes are correctly in place. Reason panel unmounts on collapse (query_selector returns None) - not a bug.
